finding: Tuner history attributes measurements to settings applied after the measured window
final_actor_reasoning: Lowering migration_cost_ns to 250us in iteration 30 caused severe CPU migration churn and L1/L2 cache invalidations, escalating Silo's p99 latency to 2.073s. Reverting migration_cost_ns to 1000000 (1ms) restores cache locality for waking transaction threads. We maintain default CFS scheduling periods (3ms min_granularity, 24ms latency, 4ms wakeup_granularity), 100% min_perf_pct, and a 5:1 cpu.weight ratio (silo 500 vs sysbench 100), which previously achieved Silo's best p99 latency (0.366s vs 0.389s bound).
interpretation: Raw window metrics/readbacks remain evidence; this run is not a clean evaluation of a correctly informed optimizer. No causal attribution of the whole performance difference is established.
note: Audit only. No code, raw measurements or knob settings were changed; no API/workload execution.
